about: The 70-year-old has documented schizophrenia and starts brand-only Eutroxsig at two 75 microgram tablets each morning on 13 January 2026.
The 72-year-old has documented schizophrenia and starts Eltroxin at one 125 microgram tablet each morning on 15 January 2026.
The 68-year-old with documented schizophrenia starts Oroxine at 50 micrograms daily and reaches 100 micrograms only through later increases.
